subject: english
question:
**Direction: Fill in the blank in the following sentence using the ANTONYM of the word given in the brackets.**

Can you ______ the UNO cards on the table? (gather)
solution: The correct answer is "spread."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word 'gather' means to come together, assemble, or accumulate. (एक साथ आते हैं; इकट्ठा करना या जमा करना) • Example: *As soon as a crowd **gathered**__, the police came.* • The antonym of 'gather' would be 'spread.' • 'Spread' means open out (something) so as to extend its surface area, width, or length. ((किसी चीज़ को) इस प्रकार खोलना कि उसका सतह क्षेत्र, चौड़ाई या लंबाई बढ़ जाए) __ • Example: *I **spread**__ a towel on the sand and sat down*. • The correct answer is option 1. **Correct sentence**: *Can you __**spread**__ the UNO cards on the table? * [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Lift: **to move somebody/something to a higher level or position. 9किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को उच्‍चतर स्‍तर या स्थिति में ले जाना, ऊपर उठाना) • **Collect: **to bring a number of things together. (विभिन्‍न वस्‍तुओं को एकत्र करना, इकट्ठा करना) • **Place: **to put something carefully or deliberately in a particular position. (विशेष स्‍थान पर कोई वस्‍तु रखना (सावधानी से या जानबूझकर)) 33:Tbe8, The correct answer is '**Promised an impossible thing**'.
